sources.name: Fiesta en el Parque at Presidio Tunnel Tops

officialTextEvents.title: Fiesta en el Parque at Presidio Tunnel Tops
officialTextEvents.description: Free family celebration of Latin culture at Presidio Tunnel Tops East Meadow, in its fourth year: salsa, merengue, and cumbia dance classes, arts and crafts, face painting, lawn games, and live performances with Golden Gate Bridge views. Presented by Telemundo 48 / NBC Bay Area with the Presidio Trust.

sources.name: Jerry Day 2026 at Jerry Garcia Amphitheater

officialTextEvents.title: Jerry Day 2026 at Jerry Garcia Amphitheater
officialTextEvents.description: Free 24th-anniversary outdoor music festival honoring Jerry Garcia at the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater in McLaren Park, presented by Friends of JGA with Avenue Greenlight and Grants for the Arts. 2026 lineup includes Melvin Seals & JGB with Jazz Mafia, Stu Allen & Mars Hotel, and Spencer Krenz & Friends. Organizers describe the festival as family friendly.

officialTextEvents.title: Gravenstein Apple Fair (Saturday)
officialTextEvents.description: Sonoma County Farm Trails' annual apple harvest fair at Ragle Ranch Park, running since 1973: all things apple, local food and drink, regional music, ag-inspired activities for all ages, and an Artisan Tasting Grove. 95% zero waste; proceeds benefit the nonprofit Sonoma County Farm Trails.
officialTextEvents.cost: Kids 5 and under free; kids 6-12 $10 advance / $15 gate; adults 13+ $23 advance / $30 gate

officialTextEvents.title: Sonoma County Fair Opening Day
officialTextEvents.description: Opening day of the Sonoma County Fair at the Sonoma County Fair and Event Center in Santa Rosa, with carnival rides, exhibits, food, and entertainment. Kids 5 and under are free; children 12 and under get free general admission on the fair's designated kids' days.

officialTextEvents.cost: Children 5 and under free; kids 6-12 $12; adults 13+ $15 advance

sources.name: 25th Annual Laurel StreetFair World Music Festival

officialTextEvents.title: 25th Annual Laurel StreetFair World Music Festival
officialTextEvents.description: Oakland's Laurel District closes MacArthur Boulevard for a free, all-ages street festival celebrating world music and the diverse cultures of the Bay Area. Two stages of live music plus a Kid's Carnival, roller skating and an art market from Black Cultural Zone, a healing village, and dozens of food, artisan, and nonprofit vendors. Draws 17,000+ neighbors each year.
